title: Custom Transparent Tray Design for Pediatric Gait Trainer
summary: Designed a lightweight, transparent tray for a pediatric gait trainer, featuring soft silicone edges for safety and object retention. Tool-free attachment allows for quick installation and removal
context: University internship — Penn State's Speech, Language, and Hearing Clinic

cover.alt: Pediatric gait trainer with transparent tray and silicone bump border

problem: One of the clinic's pediatric patients using a gait trainer required a transparent tray that would not obstruct their view or cause discomfort during therapy sessions. The clinic needed a solution that could be installed and removed without tools.
requirements: Quickly (<10 s) and easily attach and detach from the gait trainer without tools
Safe, soft edges that also work to prevent toys and objects from rolling off the tray
Cover as much area as possible while staying within the gait trainer's footprint

humanStory.abstract: A pediatric gait trainer needed a tray that let a child keep a clear view of their surroundings while keeping therapy objects close at hand.
humanStory.detail: The tray had to support the rhythm of a therapy session without becoming an obstacle: transparent material keeps the view open, soft edges help keep objects on the surface, and a tool-free mount makes it quick to take the tray on or off.

processFlow.title: Concept & user mapping
processFlow.body: Translate the clinic's need for a clear view, safer edges, quick removal and a tray that stays within the gait trainer's footprint into design constraints.

processFlow.title: Detailed design
processFlow.body: Develop the transparent tray and tool-free attachment around the trainer's footprint, keeping the surface level and the edges soft.

processFlow.title: Analysis
processFlow.body: Check the design against the practical requirements: a level tray, retained objects, a clear view and installation without tools.

processFlow.title: Fabrication & fit
processFlow.body: Bring together the transparent tray, soft silicone edging and removable mount to create a lightweight adaptation for the gait trainer.
